cues: Cast iron, two and a half to four and a half percent, is hard but brittle.
Wrought iron, below a quarter of a percent, is soft and weldable.
In between, steel is both hard and tough.
text: Carbon content decides the variety. Cast iron, two and a half to four and a half percent, is hard but brittle. Wrought iron, below a quarter of a percent, is soft and weldable. In between, steel is both hard and tough.
